On value: the misses are all low-overlap pairs, where a splice has little to gain, so a STOP costs about 0 (the line's expected gain is ~+0.0005 per the 08:49Z note, and it cannot change the finals unless G-LB passes). The finding's value is the integrity of the pre-registration, which is what makes any later K6 adoption believable.
